notes.title: Guardian Trailer 4 - Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
notes.content:
Bampuku and Mutsumi have defeated the demons that threaten their village. But further challenges await, and difficult decisions must be made...

Bampuku is Mutsumi's brother. He has a pretty laid-back personality and is gifted at cooking. 

Mutsumi holds multiple jobs in Shinju Village and never takes a break, keeping everyone slightly worried about her.

[previewyoutube=OohtU9MZuy8;full][/previewyoutube]

Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree - demo is now out!

notes.title: Guardian Trailer 3 - Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
notes.content:
Bugs. Why did it have to be bugs?! Even sneaky traps and fearsome Magaori are no match against scholar Akazu and baby-faced elder Koro. 

Akazu loves learning and usually holes up in the tower to read dense books and conduct secret experiments.

Koro is the former elder of Shinju Village and also has a great memory, shown in his ability to remember events of even when he was a kid.

[previewyoutube=bxNPg256mC8;full][/previewyoutube]

Pre-order now before it slashes your way on September 19th, 2025!

notes.title: Guardian Trailer 2 - Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
notes.content:
Magaori beware, Origami and Shigin are on the ball!

Origami is from Musuhi Village, and apparently she even acted as a stand-in elder there.

Shigin originates from a village far, far away, and he was working and living in the restaurant in Shinju Village. 

[previewyoutube=k4Qzn-vUEDA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: TOWA TALK | Shinju Village
notes.content:
There's so much to do and see in Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree:

  Have a hearty meal
  Forge your own sword at the blacksmith
  Shop for helpful items
  Train at the dojo and unlock spells
  Relax at the hot spring in the dungeons

And even more to discover!

notes.title: Guardian Trailer 1 - Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
notes.content:
With Nishiki and Rekka by your side, protecting the village will be just peachy!

Nishiki, despite his muscular stature and also the fact that he’s a humanoid koi fish (who, ironically, can’t swim), is a highly pious wanderer. 

Rekka is the founding master of the Eternal Flame Dojo, she’s pledged to be Towa’s personal guard. 

[previewyoutube=Z2z0hr0ebDw;full][/previewyoutube]
